rows.en:
I couldn't take it, and I fainted on the spot.
Of course, I lost the race.{p}

But by then, none of that mattered anymore.
I figured I was lucky just to get out of it alive.{p}

"You know too much..."
I couldn't tell if the voice was a man's or a woman's, young or old{f:.|.}
"Hello? Who is this?"
I tried speaking into the receiver.
"You would have been better off not knowing. Why do you go around digging...?"
Digging around?
What did {f:I|I} ever dig into{f:?|?}
The only reporting {f:I|I} had done was...
"Do you mean the school's seven wonders?
But what does that have to do with..."
Cutting {f:me|me} off, the voice handed down a grave sentence.{p}

The next instant, a searing pain shot through my ear.
"Ugh★"
A tingling numbness ran through me, like an electric shock.
I threw down the receiver and clutched my ear.
It was hot.
Hot liquid was oozing out, thick and slow.
Blood{f:!|!}
From the receiver lying on the floor came a voice tinged with laughter.
"I have driven a cursed needle into you.
It will bore into your brain, a needle that can never be removed..."
A cursed needle?{p}

The pain blurred my vision.
Why did this have to happen to {f:me|me}...?
As though it had heard {f:my|my} thoughts, the voice laughed again.
"I told you. You know too much... I cannot let you live."
All this, over a school's seven wonders★
I tried to scream, but no voice came out anymore.
Was it something {f:I|I} was never meant to know?
Come to think of it, anyone who could attack through a telephone couldn't be an ordinary human.{p}

{f:I|I} picked up the receiver.
"...Hello, this is {a}."
"Oh, {a}{f:|}? It's me."
"Huh?"
The voice was strangely overfamiliar.
Who on earth could it be{f:?|?}
"Aw, come on, you've forgotten me already?
We were together just a little while ago."
"Oh! Hosoda."
"Hey, you remembered me. I'm so glad.
Actually, there's something I want to talk to you about. Will you hear me out?"
"Uh, sure..."
"Thanks. I just knew you'd listen to me.
You remember Mr. Kuroki's story from earlier, right?"
"Yes."
"Y'know, even after I got home, I couldn't stop thinking about that wall.
I wonder if his story was really true."{p}

"Aren't you getting a little carried away?
{f:I|I} don't think this is a good idea."
At {f:my|my} words, Hosoda seemed to get angry.
"Come on, and you call yourself a newspaper club member★
How do you expect to cut it if you don't have the guts to charge into the scene and grab a scoop★"
He was really worked up.
Hosoda's voice was strangely harsh.
I could even hear him breathing hard through his nose.
...What should I do?{p}

"That's enough already.
Calling this late at night, you have no common sense at all!"
{f:I|I} ended up shouting before I knew it.
For a moment, Hosoda was speechless.
"...{a}{f:|}... How dare you say something like that to me, your senior..."
"If you're my senior, then why don't you act like one★
{f:I'm|I'm} sleepy. Goodbye."{p}

Convincing {f:myself|myself} of that, I crawled into bed.
...I was so wound up, I didn't think I'd ever get to sleep.{p}

"So you're awake."
That voice... Hosoda★
"Wh-why...?"
"I looked up your address in the school roster.
Forgetting to lock up... You're a careless one, aren't you?"
Giggling, Hosoda put his hand in his pocket.
What he pulled out was a fruit knife{f:.|.}
Even in the dark, I could see the blade glint.{p}

"{a}{f:|}, you made a fool of me, didn't you?
You know, I really hate being made a fool of."
He spoke in the same tone he had used that afternoon.
That made the knife clenched in his hand seem all the more out of place.
What was he {f:going|going} to do★{p}

"Sorry, but you're going to have to die.
I don't forgive anyone who makes a fool of me."{p}
Still smiling, Hosoda raised the knife high.{p}
But just then, a burning impact struck my neck.{p}

I looked down with just my eyes.
A fruit knife, stuck deep in {f:my|my} neck.{p}

"That was a close one.
But I win..."
I heard Hosoda's delighted voice.
{f:I|I} sprayed blood everywhere as I crashed to the cold floor.{p}

"I'm worn out today, so please give me a break.
If you're going, could you go by yourself?"
That was how {f:I|I} turned him down.
"I see..."
Hosoda sounded crestfallen.
Would this make him change his mind{f:?|?}
But that thought didn't last long.
"All right. Then I'll go alone."
With that, Hosoda hung up.{p}

The next day, when I got to school, the place was strangely noisy.
What had happened{f:?|?}
Spotting a classmate, {f:I|I} called out.
"Oh, morning, {a}.
They say Hosoda, the second-year, was found dead in the old school building, burned to a crisp."
Hosoda★
{f:I|I} took off running.{p}

A rope had been strung across the front of the old school building.
And in front of it stood Mr. Kuroki.{p}

When he spotted {f:me|me}, his face clouded over.
"Hosoda..."
"I heard. What happened?"
"I don't know.
But I'm sure he incurred the wrath of something lurking in the old school building."
That was what Mr. Kuroki said.{p}

Maybe so.
Hosoda had been obsessed with yesterday's story.
Just as he told {f:me|me}, he {f:must have|probably} tried to see{g} what was on the other side of that wall.
And at midnight, of all times, the hour of monsters.{p}

Laughing wildly, Hosoda switched on the saw.
Its shrill, grating whine echoed through the school at night.
Because of it, {f:I|I} never noticed the presence creeping up on us.
Just as Hosoda was about to press the spinning blade to the wall...
Someone shot past right beside {f:me|me} like the wind.{p}

It was Mr. Kuroki{f:!|!}
He shoved Hosoda aside and snatched the saw away.{p}

"I won't let them be revived!"
Mr. Kuroki raised the power saw high and came at {f:us|us}.
"Eeeek!"
Letting out a pathetic cry, Hosoda started running.
{f:I|I} followed right behind him.
"Stop☆"
Still holding the saw, Mr. Kuroki chased after us.
The roar of the motor closing in sounded just like a death sentence.{p}

"Raaaaagh☆"
Mr. Kuroki let out a roar.
Then he pressed the power saw against his own neck.
SKREEEEE☆
An awful noise rang out.{p}

Blood gushed out, and Mr. Kuroki's head went flying.
It rolled and came to a stop at {f:my|my} feet.
"Are you all right★"
The officer came running over.
We were saved{f:...|...}
The old school building and the seven wonders no longer mattered.
In my head, {f:I|I} was already planning a new feature.
What happened today would make a great article, no doubt about it.
The title would be... {f:let's see|let's see}.
'Scary Stories from School.' {f:That settles it.|That's the one.}{p}
"Hosoda, stop it!"{p}

Hosoda shoved {f:me|me} away with tremendous force.
"What do you think you're doing?!
We're about to see an amazing secret!
I can feel it! I can really feel it!
A powerful grudge is swirling around in there!
Nothing but bad things have happened at this school, since way back. There's an evil spirit here!
And it's sleeping inside this wall!
Hyaaaaaah-ha-ha-ha!"
"...Hosoda."
{f:I|I} couldn't stop him anymore.
Caught in the round glow of the flashlight, Hosoda's eyes were bloodshot, and he was cackling.{p}
Hosoda didn't care; he kept swinging the saw around, widening the hole in the wall.{p}

"Ugyaaah!"
Suddenly, an arm stretched out of the darkness deep in the wall and seized Hosoda's face.
Hosoda shook his head in agony.
But the hand clung tight and wouldn't let go.
Next, a crowd of faces rose up deep within the wall.{p}

"Life force, after so long..."
"It's delicious..."
"It's delicious..."
The faces that had been murmuring turned to look at {f:me|me}.
Were they going to drain {f:my|my} life force next{f:★|★}
Like a frog glared at by a snake, {f:I|I} couldn't move.
Long white arms were reaching toward {f:me|me}.
Was this the end{f:★|★}{p}
The instant after I closed my eyes, ready for the end, cold fingers dug into {f:my|my} forehead.{p}

"Hosoda, stop it!"
Hosoda shoved {f:me|me} away with tremendous force.
"What do you think you're doing?!
We're about to see an amazing secret!
I can feel it! I can really feel it!
A powerful grudge is swirling around in there!
Nothing but bad things have happened at this school, since way back. There's an evil spirit here!
And it's sleeping inside this wall!
Hyaaaaaah-ha-ha-ha!"
"...Hosoda."
{f:I|I} couldn't stop him anymore.
Caught in the round glow of the flashlight, Hosoda's eyes were bloodshot, and he was cackling.{p}
Hosoda didn't care; he kept swinging the saw around, widening the hole in the wall.{p}

At Hosoda's words, the girl slipped quietly out through the wall.
Her pale blue lips formed words.
"I've been in here all alone for sooo long..."
Her small hand clamped onto Hosoda's arm.
Fangs glinted.
"So I'm hungry!"{p}

The girl sank her teeth into Hosoda's throat with a chomp.
She slurped up the blood as it gushed out.
Hosoda didn't move.
Were her fangs coated with poison, or some kind of anesthetic{f:?|?}
In no time at all she had drained him dry, and then the girl looked at {f:me|me}.
"I was drenched in my big brother's blood.
Ever since then, I can't stop craving blood."
Her eyes shimmered with an iridescent sheen.
I couldn't move.
{f:Had I|I must have} already fallen under her spell, too{f:...?|...}
As {f:I|I} stood there dazed, the girl drove her sharp fangs into my neck.{p}

"Hosoda, stop it!"
Hosoda shoved {f:me|me} away with tremendous force.{p}

"What do you think you're doing?!
We're about to see an amazing secret!
I can feel it! I can really feel it!
A powerful grudge is swirling around in there!
Nothing but bad things have happened at this school, since way back. There's an evil spirit here!
And it's sleeping inside this wall!
Hyaaaaaah-ha-ha-ha!"
"...Hosoda."
{f:I|I} couldn't stop him anymore.
Caught in the round glow of the flashlight, Hosoda's eyes were bloodshot, and he was cackling.{p}

Hosoda didn't care; he kept swinging the saw around, widening the hole in the wall.
Suddenly, his movements stopped.{p}
The power saw slipped from Hosoda's hands.{p}

"Hosoda★"
When he turned around, his face was like a completely different person's.
His eyes were wide open, and drool hung from his mouth.
Then he stared at {f:me|me} and muttered,
"Food..."
just like that.
"What are you talking about?
What's wrong, Hosoda?"
As I said it, I reached out, and Hosoda bit into my arm.
His strong-looking teeth tore through skin and flesh.
"{f:Gwaaah|Aaaah}★"
In agonizing pain, {f:I|I} shoved him away.
But he got back up and came at me again.
What was going on{f:?|?}
Did he really mean to eat {f:me|me}{f:?|?}
Shielding my bleeding arm, {f:I|I} inched backward.
"Heh heh... You look delicious..."
His eyes were glazed and cloudy.
Had Hosoda been possessed{f:?|?}
That would explain the way he was acting.
But then, he really would try to eat {f:me|me}{f:.|, wouldn't he?}
What {f:was I supposed|was I supposed} to do?
While {f:I|I} was thinking, Hosoda caught me off guard and lunged at me.{p}

The blade jumped, and blood sprayed out in a burst.
A searing pain.
The saw blade had cut off {f:my|my} arm.
The wound burned as if it were being held over a flame.
Hosoda happily started gnawing on the arm lying on the floor.
Blood dripped and dripped.
It felt like my strength was rapidly draining away with the blood{f:.|.}
My legs were wobbling, too.
Like this, I'd never be able to get away from Hosoda{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} crouched down.
I could hear the crunching of bone being chewed apart.
What would it feel like to be eaten alive{f:?|?}
With any luck, I'd bleed to death before that happened.
Little by little, the darkness closed in.
Along with it, the disgusting sound of {f:my|my} arm being eaten grew fainter.
Almost welcoming it, {f:I|I} let the darkness take me in.{p}
Let's make it tomorrow
Sorry, but I'm not interested
All right. I'll go right now

"...Um, it's already late tonight, so why don't we do it tomorrow?"
I thought that would let me off the hook.
I had no intention whatsoever of going tomorrow either; I meant it as a polite way of saying no.
But on the other end of the line, Hosoda got worked up and raised his voice.
"What are you saying, {a}?
Tomorrow's too late.
If we go there in the daytime, how are we supposed to see what's behind the wall?
It has to be at night! Our only chance is now!"
Hosoda's voice was strangely harsh.
I could even hear him breathing hard through his nose.{p}...What should I do?
All right. I'll go right now
That's enough already. I'm sleepy!
Tell him to go alone and hang up
I could hardly say I didn't want to go because that place scared me. That would be way too lame.{p}
